name: ORKS: BIG MEK DAKKARIG
description:
Big Mek Dakkarigs provide a stable firing platform for heavy firepower. Lumbering relentlessly forward, they unleash corkscrewing hails of rokkits and hurricanes of dakka from their screaming blitzkannons, all while their gleeful pilot is protected from return fire by a crackling kustom force field.

Big Dakka Wherever You Need It

This multipart plastic kit builds a Big Mek Dakkarig, a huge mobile weapons platform to support your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with a recklessly rapid-firing blitzkannon and a multi-busta launcha to unleash hails of missiles, they can take on everything from masses of infantry to light armour. If the enemy gets too close, the heavy stomping feet and sheer armoured bulk will make them regret it. The Big Mek rider is protected by a kustom force field and large armoured plates, ensuring he'll stick around long enough to do some damage.

Contents:
– 44 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 90mm Round Hex Hole Base
– 1 construction guide
– 1 Orks Transfer Sheet

The Orks Transfer Sheet features 385 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Goffs, Bad Moons, Snakebites, Evil Suns, Blood Axes, and Deathskulls, as well as universal Ork glyphs, symbols, and decorations.

This push-fit miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour paints
